subject: Observability cost profile: retention, tracing & dashboard packaging
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@valence.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons — retention, trace credits and dashboard packaging

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. Valence is aligned on moving forward with Redwood for core inference, and we want to lock down observability add-ons before we sign. Two quick asks so we can finalize our internal MAS: 

1) Retention pricing: how do you price long-tail retention (30/90/365 days)? Our ingestion is spiky; we need a predictable bill for archived traces.
2) Tracing / sampled spans: can we buy a tranche of trace credits instead of per-ingest billing?
3) Dashboards: are seats required for every dashboard consumer or can we purchase a bundle of dashboards for cross-team access?

I've attached a short requirements doc that shows our monthly ingestion profile and compliance hold needs. We're hoping for a consolidated concession path — some pilot credits plus a capped overage for the first 6 months while we ramp.

Would appreciate a short written summary we can circulate to procurement.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Platform Engineering
Valence.ai

Attachment: valence-obs-requirements.pdf (PDF, 84 KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@valence.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention, trace credits and dashboard packaging

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear requirements doc, that helps a lot. Summary below so your procurement team can see the options side-by-side.

High-level: our add-ons are structured to give customers levers depending on predictability vs flexibility. Key points:
- Retention tiers: 30 / 90 / 365 configurable. Price per GB-month decreases with longer retention. For spiky workloads we recommend a committed slab (monthly GB commit) + archival tier for the long tail.
- Tracing credits: we offer two consumption models — pay-as-you-go per sampled span, or pre-purchased credit packs (e.g., 1M / 10M spans). Credit packs include a 10% volume discount and can be consumed across services.
- Dashboards: two packaging options — seat-based (named users with full edit/view controls) or org bundles (N dashboards, unlimited viewers via a shared viewer role). Bundles are usually cheaper for cross-team visibility.

Pilot concession proposal (what we can do for Valence during a 6-month ramp):
- One-time 50k trace-credit pilot to validate sampling and alerting (no charge).
- 3 months of 30-day retention at no incremental charge for up to X GB (see attachment).
- Cap on overage: 20% over committed slab billed at standard rate; we’ll review at month 4 and adjust the commit if run-rate exceeds projection.

Next steps: I attached our pricing spreadsheet (redwood-retention-pricing-v2.xlsx) with sample scenarios based on the numbers in your reqs. If the high-level framing looks good I can loop in contracts for a term sheet and a short amendment for the add-ons.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if you prefer to walk procurement through it.

Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: redwood-retention-pricing-v2.xlsx (Excel, 28 KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@valence.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention, trace credits and dashboard packaging

Marta — quick follow-up from a pricing perspective.

We reviewed Valence's profile and proposed two commercial options that balance cost predictability and overage risk:

Option A — Committed Slab (recommended for cost control):
- Commit: 5 TB/month ingestion + 90-day retention slab.
- Price: $X per TB-month (tiered) — effective blended rate ~ $Y/token.
- Tracing: buy 10M span pack at 12% discount.
- Dashboards: org bundle (10 dashboards + unlimited viewers) at a 25% discount if you sign a 12-month addendum.
- Concession: pilot credits (50k spans), month 1 retention free for up to 2 TB, 20% capped overage first 3 months.

Option B — Flexible Pay-as-you-go (recommended for uncertain ingestion):
- No commit, pay per GB-month and per sampled span.
- Tracing credit packs available anytime; larger packs get better unit economics.
- Dashboards: seat-based licensing; viewers priced lower but editors counted as seats.
- Concession: 30% discount on first 2M spans when you convert to a commit within 90 days.

If Valence is comfortable with a 12-month commit we can extend a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of the first three months' committed spend. That gets you predictable unit pricing and priority support SLAs.

I'm attaching the scenario workbook with line-by-line math. Marta — can you confirm which ingestion percentile you want us to model (p50/p90/p99)? Jordan, can you prepare the procurement-friendly SOW snippet and the addendum language?

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Commercial Strategy — Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-pricing-scenarios-workbook.xlsx (Excel, 64 KB)

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@valence.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention, trace credits and dashboard packaging

Kimberly / Rishi — thanks, this is very helpful. Quick answers from our side: 

- Model p90 ingestion for our cost planning (we included p90 numbers in the attached reqs).
- We prefer Option A (committed slab) if you can add the 12-month pricing guarantee and the onboarding credit.
- For dashboards, the org bundle makes sense — our security team will use viewers widely, and only 6 editors are needed.

Next asks: can you send a short SOW amendment with the committed slab numbers and the 12-month addendum language for procurement + a DocuSign link? If you can include the pilot credit language verbatim that will save back-and-forth.

If we can get that over by EOD Monday our procurement exec will fast-track. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Platform Engineering
Valence.ai
